g12-economics-ue4-t1.overview: Definition and Types of Macroeconomic Policies sits inside Macroeconomic Policy Instruments. Macroeconomic policy is the focus of Unit 4 of Grade 12 Economics in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it defines the main types of macroeconomic policy. Then it explains fiscal policy, its tools, and its expansionary and contractionary forms. Next, it does the same for monetary policy. Also it covers income and wage policy, including price ceilings and price floors. Finally, it examines foreign exchange policy. Students will also learn how macroeconomic policy steers real-life economies.
objectives: Distinguish fiscal, monetary, and income policy.
Compare expansionary and contractionary policy.
Explain the tools of fiscal and monetary policy.
Describe how income policy affects aggregate demand and supply.
Explain the main foreign exchange rate policies.
g12-economics-ue4-t1.simple:
Definition and Types of Macroeconomic Policies in plain words. The exam wants you to recognise the core ideas, not to memorise whole paragraphs. Focus on:
  • First, the definition of macroeconomic policy.
  • Also the difference between fiscal, monetary, and income policy.
g12-economics-ue4-t1.detailed:
Definition and Types of Macroeconomic Policies — the essentials. First, the definition of macroeconomic policy. Also the difference between fiscal, monetary, and income policy.

What the MoE expects you to be able to do:

  • Distinguish fiscal, monetary, and income policy.
  • Compare expansionary and contractionary policy.
  • Explain the tools of fiscal and monetary policy.
  • Describe how income policy affects aggregate demand and supply.
  • Explain the main foreign exchange rate policies.

keyTerms.def: First, the definition of macroeconomic policy.
Also the difference between fiscal, monetary, and income policy.
